text:
clare_ingest: Quick flag — several tenants' invoice previews diverged after we turned on the new adaptive sampler for embeddings. Preview card shows a 1.9x over-estimate in some cases.

omar_sli: I pulled traces. Two things: router tags sample_rate but some preview aggregators also multiplied by sample_weight in the aggregation step. Second, retries sometimes surface as brand-new request_ids (old SDK retry behavior) so our dedupe_by_request_id misses duplicates.

zane_billing: That aligns with ledger diffs. Our canonical dedupe key today is request_id. Short-term: we can require SDKs to populate x-client-retry-of for retries, but rollout takes time. Pragmatic path: server-side dedupe fallback via a fingerprint.

clare_ingest: Proposed fingerprint: sha1(tenant_id + '|' + model + '|' + trunc(prompt_sha1,16)). We'll attach it to raw events when available. Aggregator will use COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) as dedupe_key for rollups.

omar_sli: Performance note — hashing prompts on the hot path is non-trivial. Suggest computing fingerprint synchronously only when tokens >= 750 or tenant has flag metering_fp_sync=true. Otherwise emit dedupe_basis=pending and run async enrichment to populate fingerprint later.

zane_billing: Ledger can accept a dedupe_basis string (request_id | retry_header | fingerprint | pending). We'll require the aggregator to emit dedupe_basis so invoice rows show provenance and confidence. That will help support triage.

violet_prod: UX asks: in the preview table show a tiny "est." badge for sampled rows and a Provenance column that displays dedupe_basis and a confidence pill (high/medium/low). Hover copy should explain why preview might differ from final. Customers keep asking for more clarity.

clare_ingest: Implementation steps I'm planning: 1) ingest shim preserves and propagates x-client-retry-of and records sample_rate, 2) add fingerprint field to raw events (sync for big events, async for small), 3) move sample_weight application to a single aggregator stage (router only annotates sample_rate), 4) add x-metering-debug header that echoes dedupe_basis for canary tenants.

omar_sli: Canary plan: pick 4 tenants (small/med/large, internal-test), start at 3% traffic for 30m, metric to watch: metering.preview_to_final_ratio{route~"embeddings.*"}. Alert if >1.25 sustained for 15m. Abort threshold 1.4. Runbook: if abort, flip shim to passthrough sample_rate and disable fingerprint fallback, then run backfill to recompute previews.

zane_billing: Aggregator pseudo-SQL for rollup with fallback (illustrative):
```
WITH events AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) AS dedupe_key
  FROM raw_metering
  WHERE ingest_day = current_date
)
SELECT tenant_id, dedupe_key, SUM(tokens) * (1.0 / NULLIF(sample_rate, 1.0)) AS est_tokens
FROM events
GROUP BY tenant_id, dedupe_key;
```
Note NULLIF to avoid divide-by-zero when sample_rate == 1.0. Also we'll namespace dedupe logic per-route so we don't fingerprint for routes that must remain exact.

violet_prod: Console owner note: i'll add the Provenance column and the small_est badge mock. Also add a link from the badge to billing docs explaining dedupe_basis semantics.

audit-bot: deploy queued: canary/metering-shim v4.0 -> staging (owner: clare_ingest) :rocket:

clare_ingest: I'll post the RFC with acceptance criteria and sample payloads. Also adding a short checklist for the SRE runbook: dashboards to watch, actions to take on abort, and who to pager.

omar_sli: i'll own the Grafana panels and alerts for the canary window. Please ping when the canary starts.

zane_billing: i'll run a shadow ledger ingest for canary tenants and post diffs at +2h. If deltas look good we'll proceed to broader rollout.

clare_ingest: thanks all 44d
